cards.title: Порядок слов
cards.mistake: Want I a ticket. / I ticket want.

cards.title: he / she / it + -s
cards.formula: I/you/we/they → go, want · he/she/it → goes, wants

cards.title: to be: am / is / are
cards.formula: I am · he/she/it is · you/we/they are
cards.mistake: I is tired. / She are here.

cards.title: Артикли: a / the / ∅
cards.formula: a = один считаемый · the = тот самый · страны/еда-категория без a
cards.mistake: a Thailand / a help / to airport
